Event types: athleteUp (confidence 0.4–0.6 inferred from scores or directly signalled), greenLight (0.9 if signalled, 0 if recording), routineEnded, scorePosted (0.95), scoreCorrected (0.95), rotationChanged, teamTotalChanged. State used by guardrails.setRoutineStateProvider() and Xavier decision service. Per-instance keeps 200 recent events in memory.

what_it_does: Four rules that refuse risky scene and graphic actions from any sender unless forced by a human: minShotHoldMs (scene-hold minimum), noCutDuringRoutine (when a routine is in progress), noGraphicStacking (two graphics at once), cameraMustHaveSignal (take video from all active inputs).
control_detail: competitions/{compId}/config/xavier/guardrails = {enabled, rules: {minShotHoldMs: {enabled, holdMs}, ...}}; rules read live from Firebase, default all on with 3000ms hold time when missing
evidence: server/lib/guardrails.js (4 rule engines, 27 unit tests pass ISA2-273); server/__tests__/guardrails.test.js; verified on test VM (ISA2-273); rules integrated into action bus (ISA2-272)
depends_on: Action bus (hooks into every command), Competition state service (for noCutDuringRoutine via setRoutineStateProvider), OBS integration (cameraMustHaveSignal probes GetMediaInputStatus)
known_gaps: noCutDuringRoutine is inert until routine state provider is set (ISA2-274, in progress); force:true only works for human senders (producer, rundown, not Xavier); Producer View does not yet show refusals to the producer or offer a second-tap override; noGraphicStacking definition (one in same registry category only) not yet validated with Isaac
notes: ISA2-273. minShotHoldMs default 3000ms; noCutDuringRoutine needs routine state from competition state service; noGraphicStacking compares currentGraphic category against candidate; cameraMustHaveSignal calls GetSceneItemList + GetMediaInputStatus on every ffmpeg_source/vlc_source nested inside the target scene, OBS timeout 1.5s allows.
